instruction: Compare iPhone 15 Pro with iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 13 Pro

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing 3 iPhone Pro models (non-Max versions) on Apple's website. Evaluator checks that the active tab URL contains the modelList parameter with the 3 specified iPhone Pro models (order-independent). Similar complexity to original task, just different model selection focusing on Pro models.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_url_parse extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree and parses the 'modelList' query parameter
URL parsing correctly handles Apple's comparison page format with split_list:true to parse comma-separated model values
Metric logic is correct: check_direct_json_object compares the extracted modelList against expected values with order-independent matching (ignore_list_order:true)
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies all 3 required iPhone Pro models are present in the comparison URL
Expected values are semantically correct: The model slugs (iphone-15-pro, iphone-14-pro, iphone-13-pro) match Apple's URL format
Edge case handling: If modelList parameter is missing or empty, get_active_tab_url_parse returns None and check_direct_json_object correctly returns 0.0
Order independence is appropriate: The instruction doesn't specify a particular order for comparison, so ignore_list_order is semantically correct
